works.author: Daniel Ross Luft for Heyo
works.comment: 高尔夫挥杆分析软件 Arc 的移动端落地页：深色界面配手持手机样机，挥杆数据 162.9 直接钉在首屏，"Drop It / Own It / Swing It" 三步流程把产品价值讲清了，工具类 App 的营销页可借鉴。
works.comment_en: Landing page for Arc, a golf-swing analysis app: dark UI with a hand-held phone mockup, swing stat 162.9 pinned front and center — the "Drop It / Own It / Swing It" three-step flow nails product value, worth studying for tool-app marketing pages.
works.title: Arc Mobile Screens

works.author: Nixtio
works.comment: 单车租赁 App：3D 城市地图上叠放附近车辆与站点卡片，"Nearby now"、37 辆车、"#45 Riverside Walk" 站点信息一屏读完，地图类 App 的信息叠加层值得学。
works.comment_en: Bike-rental app with a 3D city map layered with nearby-vehicle and station cards — "Nearby now," 37 bikes, and the "#45 Riverside Walk" stop all readable at a glance; a lesson in map-overlay layering.
works.title: Bike Rental & Navigation App UI Design

works.author: Mahid
works.comment: 深色财务运营仪表盘 "Vantage"（视频）：现金流图表、资金跑道与预算面板同屏排布，金融后台的数据密度与留白平衡得不错。
works.comment_en: Dark finance-ops dashboard "Vantage" (video): cash-flow charts, runway, and budget panels share one screen — a good balance of data density and breathing room for finance back offices.
works.title: Dashboard UI Design

works.author: Halo UI/UX for HALO LAB
works.comment: 医疗公司 "Satelia" 官网（视频）："Remote patient support" 主视觉配心脏监测板块与医生形象图，医疗类站点建立信任感的叙事节奏可参考。
works.comment_en: Healthcare company site "Satelia" (video): "Remote patient support" hero with a heart-monitoring section and clinician imagery — a trust-building narrative rhythm worth borrowing for healthcare sites.
works.title: Website for a Healthcare Company ✦ Satelia

works.author: Zakariya Buhari
works.comment: 小企业现金流仪表盘 "Ledra"：现金健康分 74、资金跑道 14.2 个月，余额/消耗/待收卡片配预测图表与待办提醒，SaaS 仪表盘把"钱还剩多久"讲得一目了然。
works.comment_en: Small-business cash-flow dashboard "Ledra": health score 74, 14.2 months of runway, balance/burn/receivables cards with forecast charts and reminders — answers "how long will the money last" at a glance.
works.title: Ledra: Cash-Flow Dashboard for Small Businesses

works.author: Jahid Hasan
works.comment: 旅行徒步 App 三屏动画流程（视频）：欢迎页→发现页→目的地详情与预订按钮，一镜到底的动效把"想走就走"的情绪拉满，出行类 App 的转场设计范例。
works.comment_en: Travel/trekking app in a three-screen animated flow (video): welcome → discover → destination detail with a book button, one continuous take — the transitions sell the "just go" feeling, a reference for travel-app motion.
works.title: Travel & Trekking Mobile App UI/UX – Animated Flow

works.author: JK Mahbub
works.comment: AI 平台网站动效设计（视频）：深色 DevOps/云基础设施风，"For Growing Tech Teams" 开场，AI 工具类站点的深色质感与动效叙事可借鉴。
works.comment_en: AI platform site motion design (video): dark DevOps/cloud-infra aesthetic opening on "For Growing Tech Teams" — dark-mode texture and motion storytelling worth borrowing for AI tool sites.
works.title: AI Website | Motion
